item.title: Two imaging techniques equally effective for guiding complex stenting
item.description: Optical coherence tomography was as effective as intravascular ultrasound for guiding stenting in patients with left main coronary artery disease, according to a recent study.

item.title: Classroom dust bacteria linked to reduced lung function in children
item.description: Common bacteria found in classroom dust are associated with reduced lung function in children, according to research presented at the European Respiratory Society meeting.

item.title: AI chatbots often downplay sleep apnea symptoms, study finds
item.description: In a third of cases, AI chatbots incorrectly reassure sleep apnea patients that their symptoms are not serious, potentially discouraging them from seeking a referral.

item.title: Endometriosis often goes undiagnosed for years; here's what to know
item.description: When Zoë Armstrong received an ultrasound report indicating endometriosis, she cried with relief after years of suffering and seeking help. The disease frequently eludes diagnosis for years.
